full.en: ORGANIC ACTIVE SPORT MUESLI with apricot, fig, maca & chia. Ingredients: OAT flakes * (36%), WHEAT flakes * (WHEAT, BARLEY malt extract) (18%), figs * (17%), sunflower seeds * (9%), apricot * (9%), buckwheat * (6%), sprouted 4 seed granola * (buckwheat, SESAME seeds, sunflower seeds, flax seeds, figs, apricots, raisins) (5%), chia seeds (Salvia hispanica) * (1%), maca powder (Lepidium meyenii) * (1%). * organic. Contains naturally present sugars. May contain traces: PEANUTS, SOY, MILK and NUTS. Storage: Store in a cool and dry place. Neto weight 350 g. Best before end: see top of the bag. It is recommended not to exceed the dose of 15 g of chia seeds per day!
full.sl: BIO ACTIVE SPORT MUSLI z marelico, figo, maco & chia semeni. Sestavine: OVSENI kosmiči * (36%), PŠENIČNI kosmiči * (PŠENICA, izvleček JEČMENOVEGA slada) (18%), fige * (17%), sončnična semena * (9%), marelice * (9%), ajda * (6%), granola iz 4 semen * (ajda, SEZAMOVA semena, sončnična semena, lanena semena, fige, marelice, rozine) (5%), seme oljne kadulje (Salvia hispanica) * (1%), maca v prahu (Lepidium meyenii) * (1%). * ekološko. Vsebuje naravno prisotne sladkorje. Lahko vsebuje sledove: ARAŠIDI, SOJA, MLEKO in OREŠČKI. Shranjevanje: hladen in suh prostor. Neto količina 350 g. Uporabno najmanj do: datum odtisnjen na zgornjem delu vrečke. Priporočljivo je, da se ne presega odmerek 15 g chia semen na dan!
